Dispatch status: On schedule indicates the driver is not under pressure and is proceeding normally. Therefore, no adjustment to the baseline severity is warranted.
The dispatch status indicates the driver executed a documented defensive maneuver, demonstrating safe handling of a potential hazard. This is evidence of driver control and reduces the risk.
